_purpose: D1 — Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) between zA (measurement-MLP) and zB (passive-CNN) on the §5.7 baseline at lambda_C=0.0 (pre-alignment condition).
_notes: lambda_c=0.0 selects the pre-alignment-training baseline — same arch as §5.7 but no cross-pathway L_C term.
Bootstrap CI is computed by resampling rows of the (zA, zB) eval matrix; reports 95% (2.5/97.5 percentile) for both linear_cka and rbf_cka.
If n_eval_paired < 100, runner aborts and writes HONEST_NEGATIVE per spec.
